adversarial_claim: The resource service reports the same completed read twice under two event_id and jti values, and the second report counts as a second success.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Execution completed with data returned': EXECUTION, SUCCESS, reliability; counts toward reliability. The cited record names the declared executor (14.2).

Draft 14.6 rule 4 and 14.3: same (task_id, operation_id, event_kind, dimension, reporter) tuple as execution-event-0001, so it gets a DUPLICATE acknowledgment and casts no second vote. Its (iss, jti) is new, so it is not an identical retry (7.5). Not listed in qualified_event_ids (15.2).
